scope: Native empty-slot and offline synthetic-file checks; no real card emulation

cases.name: help
cases.output:
Prism2Genesis 0.3.0-alpha.1 - experimental Genesis RAM probe
  Prism2Genesis --version
  Prism2Genesis backup --output NEW_DIRECTORY --utc YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ
  Prism2Genesis info
  Prism2Genesis inspect
  Prism2Genesis probe --sram 8|16
info reads CIS only; inspect initializes the card and reads firmware/PDA.
probe resets the card and writes four RAM bytes, then restores normal mode.
Native inspect/probe are blocked until verified full-flash backup is available.
backup reads all AUX NV addresses twice; it never initializes or resets the card.
Select SRAM width from the exact card's hardware documentation.
No firmware loading or flash programming is implemented in this milestone.
